axisConvention: Viewed from tail toward nose: kickflip is positive long, heelflip negative long, frontside positive vertical, backside negative vertical, nose-forward positive cross.

tricks.name: Ollie
tricks.description: The board rises without a flip or spin.

tricks.name: Kickflip
tricks.description: The board makes one kickflip-direction roll along its length.

tricks.name: Heelflip
tricks.description: The board makes one roll opposite to a kickflip.

tricks.name: Pop shove-it
tricks.description: The board makes a backside half-turn around the vertical axis.

tricks.name: Frontside 180
tricks.description: The board makes a frontside half-turn around the vertical axis (board rotation only; rider body rotation is not scored).

tricks.name: Varial kickflip
tricks.description: A kickflip is combined with a backside half shove-it.

tricks.name: 360 flip
tricks.description: A kickflip is combined with one backside vertical-axis turn.

tricks.name: Hardflip
tricks.description: A kickflip is combined with a frontside half shove-it.

tricks.name: Impossible
tricks.description: The board wraps once nose-forward around the back foot, modeled on the cross axis.

tricks.name: Laser flip
tricks.description: A heelflip is combined with one frontside vertical-axis turn.

tricks.name: Nollie
tricks.description: The board rises from a nose pop without a flip or spin.

tricks.name: Late flip
tricks.description: After a delay in the air, the board makes one kickflip-direction roll.

tricks.name: Half kickflip
tricks.description: The board makes only a half kickflip-direction roll along its length and comes down on its side.

tricks.name: Half heelflip
tricks.description: The board makes only a half roll opposite to a kickflip and comes down on its side.

tricks.name: Half varial kickflip
tricks.description: A half kickflip is combined with a backside half shove-it; the board comes down on its side.

tricks.name: Half 360 flip
tricks.description: A half kickflip is combined with one backside vertical-axis turn; the board comes down on its side.

tricks.name: Half hardflip
tricks.description: A half kickflip is combined with a frontside half shove-it; the board comes down on its side.

tricks.name: Half impossible
tricks.description: The board wraps only halfway nose-forward around the back foot, modeled on the cross axis.

tricks.name: Half laser flip
tricks.description: A half heelflip is combined with one frontside vertical-axis turn; the board comes down on its side.

tricks.name: Half late flip
tricks.description: After a delay in the air, the board makes only a half kickflip-direction roll.

tricks.name: One-and-a-half kickflip
tricks.description: The board makes one and a half kickflip-direction rolls along its length and cannot land on its wheels.

tricks.name: One-and-a-half heelflip
tricks.description: The board makes one and a half rolls opposite to a kickflip and cannot land on its wheels.

tricks.name: One-and-a-half impossible
tricks.description: The board wraps one and a half times nose-forward around the back foot, modeled on the cross axis.

tricks.name: One-and-a-half varial kickflip
tricks.description: One and a half kickflip-direction rolls are combined with a backside half shove-it; the board cannot land on its wheels.
